description: One single white checkmark on a blue circular medallion UI icon. A clearly readable bold check mark with short lower left arm and long upper right arm. No handle or stem. No magnifying glass. Crisp cozy 16-bit pixel fishing RPG UI, dark brown one pixel outlines, 3 shades per material, saturated clear colors, warm brass highlights. Transparent background. No text. No blur, no smooth gradients.
